title: Quality complaint cluster on batch B-ANM02-2608

evidence.label: Batch complaint cluster
evidence.caption: Several customers complaining about the same batch is a quality pattern. Strata routes it to the QA head and never acts on it automatically.
evidence.definition: Quality-kind complaints for the same batch_id from >=2 distinct accounts within 21 days.
evidence.note: 7 quality complaints from 3 accounts in 21 days

narrative.text: Batch complaint cluster or possible adverse-event wording: Batch complaint cluster: 7 quality complaints from 3 accounts in 21 days.
The cause rule that fits best is batch quality; the customer-side symptoms follow from it rather than from a demand change.

Organizational memory's closest match is INC-010 (Cluster of packaging complaints on one batch from a stockist region), resolved by: Route to QA head, four-eyes review of the cluster, batch hold decision by QA.
This is a regulatory-sensitive pattern, so Strata only routes it to the QA head for a four-eyes review and proposes no other action.

steps.action: Review receivables ageing and current credit exposure
Contact the account to understand the cause of delay
Propose a payment plan with a reduced credit limit
Decide on payment plan or credit hold
Apply the decided order release rule in operations
Escalate overdue balance to finance and business head
Place the account on credit hold
Negotiate recovery of the overdue balance
